A draft chapter. It has no `publishedOn`, so it stays out of the RSS feed,
and its status pill reads "draft". It exists so the reader has a third
chapter: chapter two then has both a previous and a next link.

Ines found the second ledger on the seventh night, wrapped in oilcloth and
pushed into the gap between two stones under the bridge. It was bound in grey,
not green, and every page was full.
